description:
## Why

A pub fn in production code reads as API. A future agent cannot tell that a helper exists only so a test can look inside, so it gets reused and the test-only surface becomes load-bearing.

## Signal, corrected

dead_code already proves no pub(crate)/pub(super)/private function is test-only: in a non-test lib build such an item has zero callers and warns, and cargo build is clean under -D warnings. The blind spot is fully-pub items, which the lint exempts as public API.

The first scan said 42. It was wrong: it looked for 'pub fn' per file without checking whether the declaring module is #[cfg(test)]-gated. The true count is 30, of which 7 live in causal.rs and leave the lib with fz-foq.3, so 23 are in scope for fz-foq.4. They split into public API (where no in-repo caller is expected) and internal accessors that leaked pub.

## The integration-test constraint

tests/ (aot_variadic_open, fixture_matrix, fz2_cli) compiles against the lib as an EXTERNAL crate and cannot see #[cfg(test)] items. The test files cannot move into the lib either: all three use env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_fz2"), which cargo defines only for integration-test targets, and fixture_matrix is harness = false with libtest-mimic generating trials dynamically. They are black-box tests that spawn the built binary, so tests/ is correct on the merits.

The fix is therefore to move the SUPPORT, not the tests. fz-foq.1 established the pattern: a standalone module with no production consumer becomes a dev-dependency crate that both lib unit tests and tests/ share.

## State

- fz-foq.1 DONE -- fz-fixture-metadata extracted; 475 lines and 7 tests left the compiler lib.
- fz-foq.2 DONE -- transport_test no longer audits the gated fixture_facts as a production order authority. Its original premise, 'gate fixture_facts', was already true on main.
- fz-foq.3 -- causal.rs (1960 lines) is test assertion vocabulary, not an analysis library: three consumers, all tests. It goes to a dev-dependency crate, but AFTER fz-0am shrinks it. Blocked by fz-0am.
- fz-foq.4 -- the 23. Blocked by fz-foq.3 so the causal entries are gone from the list first.
- fz-foq.5 -- run_root_jit repeats compile_root_jit inline; a fold, not a deletion. Independent.
- fz-foq.6 -- five *Work counter bags, 43 u64 fields, into one summable shape. After fz-0am, which changes which counters exist.
- fz-foq.7 -- five report fields that serve one assertion each. After fz-0am and fz-foq.3.

## Goal

Every fully-pub function is either called from production, deliberately named as API, or behind cfg(test). Then dead_code alone is a sufficient gate and this scan never needs repeating.
title: Move test-only helpers out of the production surface
